body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0077 {
  meta:
    author = "DaC"
    description = "Sysmon: LOLBins initiating outbound network connections - Detects Sysmon network connections initiated by common LOLBins often used for tool transfer or staging."
    severity = "Medium"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0077"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1105"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINDOWS_SYSMON"
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /(powershell|pwsh|mshta|rundll32|regsvr32|bitsadmin|certutil)\.exe/ nocase
    $name = $e.principal.hostname
    $name_ = $e.principal.user.userid
    $path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path

  match:
    $name, $name_, $path over 1h

  outcome:
    $count = count($e.metadata.id)
    $dest_ips = count_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $ports = array_distinct($e.target.port)

  condition:
    $e and $count >= 10 and $dest_ips >= 5
}
